name: Kickstart (VST3)
description: A kick drum synthesiser: no samples, every hit synthesised. Acoustic kicks, the classic drum machines, and gabber, hardstyle, dubstep, techno rumble and the trap 808, from twenty-one controls rather than one simulation per style. The trick is that they all live on the same few physical axes: how far the pitch falls and how fast, how the body dies away, how much of a real drum head is in it, what the beater is made of. Then a transient shaper that reads the kick's own envelopes, four drives from Battlestar Overdrive, a compressor, and thirty-one presets in three banks.
note: Windows VST3 + standalone · build 260926.2 · free download · 21 controls · acoustic / classic / modern · 4 Battlestar drives · transient + comp · 31 presets · manual included.
